styles.label: Galaxy class

alcove.description: Full-width open recess, no door between corridor and standing area

pieces.name: 2 × 2 Jefferies access alcove

serviceAccess.destination: Reserved for a future Jefferies route or vertical shaft; not an open passage into empty space

pieces.notes: Exactly 3 × 3 m clear floor. Hatch, release panel and ribs stay in the wall band; no furniture, ladder or console consumes the standing area. Not a turbolift.

placementRule: Replace one straight corridor spacer with H10-J and connect J01-A to its inboard alcove port. Prefer a spacer between cabins, separate from the turbolift bay. Check footprint clearance before placement.
productionRules: Generate each corridor master in both styles against the same approved geometry.
Final map assets must be truly orthographic overhead, with ceiling removed and no perspective foreshortening.
Ribs, light strips and carpet borders must align across straight pieces, bends and caps and leave 3 m clear passage width.
Do not paint the current uniform shared carpet overlay over the new runner and edge-band art; provide style-specific floor layers.
Room doorway leaves stay separate and use native Foundry animation; the alcove mouth has no door leaf.
Access hatch remains a closed visual feature until a real route, shaft or destination exists. Do not export an orphan hatch door.
Study boards are not production assets and must not be substituted into the runtime puzzle library.
